regime_context: The TSX thematic landscape is led by Big Banks with high momentum, broad breadth, and a durable-looking trend (durability 0.74), but the theme is crowded (z=1.59). The absolute-trend gate is ON for the majority of eligible themes, which is the one validated risk-control edge; themes like Technology and Gold Miners are ineligible. Rotation breadth is broad (62% eligible) with no one-narrative regime, and macro headlines are dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics (unscheduled share 0.80). Given the detector is display-only and has no forward-return edge outside of drawdown avoidance, any lean is a pure risk/hypothesis framing.

I lean overweight to reflect staying power, but crowding dictates a size-down posture; the overweight is a directional lean only, not a sizing call.
